prompts.01-light-floating-video.png:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: refined high-fidelity Android home screen proposal for Hush, based on an inspected running app.
Input image: reference screenshot of the actual application, NOT an edit target. Preserve its product structure and branding while improving layout.
Output: one crisp flat full-screen portrait mobile UI screenshot, 9:20 aspect ratio, no physical phone, no perspective, no outside labels. Native Android styling, Manrope-like restrained sans-serif, 20dp page gutters, 48dp minimum tappable controls. Minimal, implementable, polished.
Actual app structure to retain: compact top header with standalone lowercase rounded h mark and "Hush" wordmark left, small outline incognito mask and overflow dots right. EXACTLY three persistent bottom navigation destinations: "Search", "Games", "Breathe". Search uses magnifier icon, Games uses gamepad, Breathe uses rounded lowercase h icon as current app. Search selected with pale sage capsule behind icon. Add modest readable 12sp labels under each icon, all three fully visible and equal widths. Navigation is a slim warm-stone rounded tray above Android gesture safe area, 72dp tall. No extra tabs or profile button.
Home body: one simple 52dp-high rounded tonal search input labelled exactly "Search YouTube" with small magnifier; horizontally aligned 20dp gutters, placed in upper quarter of screen below header with 64dp breathing room. Its text normal body size 16sp, not oversized CTA. Under input, one short row of OPTIONAL recent search chips, small clock icon and exact labels "lofi", "jazz", "ambient", each 32dp high. No other content. Majority of home stays calm empty space; games and breathing live in their respective tabs so no home dashboard, no games cards, no meditation hero, no library tray, no greeting, no recommendations.
Video change: replace bottom collapsed player entirely with a small FLOATING VIDEO PiP-style window within the home. This is an in-app floating video design, not a full width bottom strip. Anchor lower-right with 20dp right margin and at least 24dp clear gap ABOVE bottom navigation. Window approximately 192x108dp, true 16:9 video, rounded 14dp corners, subtle shadow, showing warm anime-style desk scene with headphones and city window (illustrative example of YouTube lofi video already playing). Small semi-transparent close X top-right and expand icon top-left; small circular pause control at center. Controls wholly inside video frame, no metadata footer, no progress strip, no additional player, never cover navigation or search. Avoid exact reproduction of copyrighted character identity; use generic desk scene.
Status bar 9:41 and Android gesture line. No bottom audio bar anywhere. No UI duplications, no invented stats, no giant logos, no gradients, no glass. Exact supplied text and destination order.
Primary request: Recommended LIGHT active-video home: warm paper #F6F3EB background, dark pine #24483D text/icons, muted #536257 secondary ink. Search input pale sage #E7EEE5 with fine #C7D1C7 outline; recent chips quiet stone #EEEAE1. Bottom nav stone #EEEAE1; selected Search indicator pale sage. Keep the screen beautifully sparse with huge intentional blank region between search and floating video. No bright primary green search bar. Video approximately half screen width and does NOT touch the navigation.
